captions.detailed: An open timber belfry constructed with a dark brown wooden frame, four vertical posts, and a dark grey gabled saddle roof. Suspended from a horizontal headstock between the upper support beams is a classic brass-colored bell. The bell is mounted on a revolute joint, allowing it to swing freely back and forth about the horizontal axis of its suspension bar.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an open timber belfry featuring four sturdy round posts, a square platform, a dark-colored gabled saddle roof, and a brass-colored bell. The bell should be mounted to swing on a horizontal revolute joint relative to the support frame.
captions.factory: Construct the belfry frame by placing cylinder primitives for the four vertical posts, then arrange box primitives to form the square platform, cross-beams, and roof rafters. Create the gabled roof using thin flat boxes angled to form the pitch. Model the bell by lofting or revolving a profile (or combining a conical cylinder and a torus) in brass material, and attach it to a central horizontal axle via a revolute articulation joint.
